persona: Mid-level statistical programmer at a CRO with no submission validation work yet
resumeText:
Priya Venkataraman | Bengaluru | priya.venkataraman@example.com

SUMMARY
Statistical programmer with five years in clinical trial reporting for oncology and respiratory studies.

EXPERIENCE
Statistical Programmer, Nilgiri Clinical Analytics Pvt Ltd, Bengaluru (Jun 2021 - present)
- Programmed SDTM domains (DM, AE, LB, VS) from raw EDC data for Phase II and III oncology studies.
- Built ADaM datasets including ADSL and ADAE following the ADaM IG and study specifications.
- Wrote Base SAS and SAS macro programs to produce safety tables, listings and figures for clinical study reports.
- Performed independent double programming to validate outputs against the statistical analysis plan.
- Derived efficacy endpoints using PROC MIXED and PROC LIFETEST with guidance from the study biostatistician.
- Presented programming status and open data issues in weekly study team calls.

EDUCATION
MSc Statistics, Bangalore University, 2021

SKILLS
SAS 9.4, R (basic), SQL, Microsoft Office
